## Current projects

::: {.timeline-entry}
### [BiodivPond Pilot](https://biodivpond.github.io) · 2026--2028

Biodiversity monitoring of ponds: evaluating the applicability of novel methods and identifying obstacles to wide use, as part of the [Biodiversa+ partnership](https://www.biodiversa.eu/). I coordinate this pilot, which builds a transnational pond monitoring network across Europe, designs citizen-science-based monitoring schemes, and delivers open-access data infrastructure.

*HORIZON-CL6-2021-BIODIV-02, WP 2.6.8* &nbsp;·&nbsp; [Website](https://biodivpond.github.io) · [GitHub](https://github.com/BiodivPond)
:::
